text_block_list.text:
One day during lunch break. While I was 
with Espoir City, Transcend came over to 
talk to us.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Hey hey, Espo-n. Wanna go catch a little 
vibe of America?"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Hah? What's your problem all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Look at this street. It's lined with 
authentic shops and has such an American 
vibe, right? Let's check it out on our 
next day off!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Things are totally different overseas 
compared to Japan, right? If you're aiming 
for the BC, it's gotta be important to 
know that kind of stuff.
choice_data_list:
True, it wouldn't hurt to get a feel for 
the atmosphere before heading to America.

True, it wouldn't hurt to get a feel for 
the atmosphere before heading to America, 
huh?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Tch, fine, guess I got no choice.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... So this is the "American air," 
huh.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Oh. This souvenir jacket looks pretty rad. 
Hey pops, how much for this?

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Uhhh... Do you speak English? ...The 
jacket really suits your vibe, though!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Suits... your buy-zone? What the 
heck, you're talking way too fast...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Wanna try using a translation app on your 
phone? If we test it out now, it'll 
totally come in handy when it counts~.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Tch, I don't even want that crap! 
—M-Mister! How much?!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
As expected of the real deal! Even a small 
is this huge. This kinda cultural gap is 
definitely something you gotta experience 
early on.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hah, 'authentic' my foot. I could easily 
down an L-size in one go! Just you watch!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Ugh! Guh...! I-It's insanely huge...!
choice_data_list: Maybe you should just give up?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"You idiot! If you tap out, they'll look 
down on us in the real-deal places too! 
Just watch, I'm gonna clean my whole 
plate!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Aahhh... Whew... Walking a bit really did 
help, I guess...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
To actually finish it all, as expected of 
Espo-n♪ Well~, it made for great practice, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Well, I guess I got a little taste of what 
America feels like.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"...I mean, hey. Why the hell did you 
suddenly invite me out?"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hmm~? ...Hehe. Well, I guess it's my 
way... of sayin' thanks.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Actually, ya know... I've decided what I'm 
aiming for. —Dubai.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Look, it's like one of the most 
cutting-edge futuristic cities in the 
world, right? Getting to run there gives 
me absolute chills!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
At the same time, though, I really feel 
how high the bar is. It's packed with 
powerhouses, and the "away game" pressure 
is intense.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
“Still, watching Espo-n aim straight for 
the BC— something inside me just clicked, 
y'know~?”

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
“Top contenders? Away ground? It's just a 
different field, right? Then there's no 
way I'm gonna lose either!” ...is what she 
said.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
And then, the chills and the fire in my 
belly just wouldn't stop!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
In other words, the reason I felt ready to 
take that step was all thanks to you, 
Espo-n. That's what I really wanted to 
tell you.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Huuuh?! A-Are you stupid... Like hell I'd 
care about that!
choice_data_list:
But you can hold your head high, can't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Shuuut up, don't say weird stuff! I'm... 
even I—damn it!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Espon?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
—Hey, Tran!! If you're aiming for the 
world too, then you're my rival!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
You bringing me along today— I ain't gonna 
leave that as an unpaid debt!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"I'll repay that debt—with my running! I'm 
gonna win and blow your freakin' mind! 
Just you wait and see!"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...Nihihi♪ Well then, as your rival, I'll 
be scooping up plenty of intel too♪

With shopping and eating done, they 
strolled around town. Still buzzing with 
excitement from their earlier 
conversation, Espoir City and the others—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Oh, an open track. Hey, Es-po, wanna go 
for a quick race?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Ha... bring it on! Hey, Trainer. You be 
the judge, got it?

The two of them gazed out at the track 
bathed in twilight. I could only look on 
in awe at their radiant profiles.
